player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ Nim.
Wo botae ne sɛ wo bɛfa ade a aka no.
Wɔ kɔla biara mu no, fa pile baako pɛ na yi ade baako anaa pii afi mu.
Fa nsɛm format yi '[pile quantity]', baako pile yɛ pile index na quantity yɛ ade dodo a wobɛyi afi mu.
Sɛ nhwɛso, '[0 3]' yi ade 3 afi pile 0 mu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Wannya ntutu akwan a ɛfata. Fa '[pile quantity]' di dwuma.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Adwuma a woyɛ no mfa. Kɔla {col} no wɔ asɛmti.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ɔbo a wɔato no {pile_index} nni mu.
invalid_move.non_positive: Ɛsɛ sɛ woyi ade biako a anyɛ yiye koraa no fi hɔ.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Wo ntumi nfi {quantity} fi kɔla {pile_index} mu (ɛwɔ {pile_count} nko ara).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} dii adwuma [{pile_index} {quantity}], fi {quantity} biribi(abi) fi kɔla {pile_index} mu.

outcome.win: Ɔbɔfo {player_id} na ɔfaa ade a etwa to no!
